text: Closed by m1's 4383a85 (landed on main). Verified the fix rather than taking the commit subject for it: validated() now compares each unit's text against canonicalText sliced at its span hull, accumulating via ValidatedNec. Two judgement calls in the implementation are documented in the source and both are right -- the hull comparison so a discontinuous SpanSet is checked as covered extent (a unit spanning two sentences legitimately carries the text between them), and an explicit length guard because validated accumulates rather than short-circuits, so a graph already failing spanCheck would otherwise throw on substring. m1's framing of why it mattered: the recall checksum commits to both text and span, so it faithfully IDENTIFIES an incoherent graph and never REFUSES one -- identity is not validity.
